hotels.title: Self-Contained Apartments near Lake Tekapo with Mountain Views, Outdoor Pool & BBQ Area
hotels.description: Discover the beauty of New Zealand's South Island with a charming self-contained apartment stay moments from the spectacularly turquoise Lake Tekapo. Take in breathtaking alpine vistas and huddle around the outdoor fireplace on chilly evenings. For those eager to explore, the Aoraki Mackenzie International Dark Sky Reserve promises extraordinary stargazing beneath some of the clearest skies on earth. Back at the property, fire up the BBQ for a relaxed evening feast or unwind in the heated outdoor pool and soothing hot tub. Then retreat to your private haven, thoughtfully appointed with all the comforts of home.
